Lemma 4.10 is done (BoundedDiagramLift.lean, PlacedTesting.lean). Statement changes: the old statement was vacuous, since each test clause carried D.t μ ≤ Model.card B while Model.card B = μ < D.t μ (StableDiagram.above). Now the lift clauses are at the bounded levels ρ < μ (the diagrams D(d, X; B), |X| < μ, whose thresholds lie below μ), J is produced with D.t μ ≤ ‖E(J)‖, and uniqueness is the level-μ comparison over all of A; added [CategoricalUnbounded K], hcat : Categorical K μ, ℵ₀ ≤ σ, and hg : PlacedTester K E D g. PlacedTester is the English Prop 4.8 over the base (placements of a σ-tuple over E(I) that differ over A differ over ≤ g(σ) positions of I); it is proved as proposition_4_8_over_base / exists_placedTester from Lemma 4.7 (type_u_witness_set) by the frozen-data / ordinal-vector argument, because proposition_4_8 on the support encoding only tests two full lists on their own joint support. So lemma_4_7 → proposition_4_8 is hard again, and proposition_4_8, proposition_4_2 (strong maps B → E(I) fixing parameters), proposition_4_3 (common hulls, categoricity at μ) → lemma_4_10 are hard.

Statement changes: added [CategoricalUnbounded K], E : OrderPresentation K, hg : PlacedTester K E D g (replacing the monotone-only g). Clause 2: added ℵ₀ ≤ σ; the old right side was vacuous (tests at level μ under D.t μ ≤ Model.card Bᵢ = μ < D.t μ); it is now the tests at the bounded levels ρ < μ (as in lemma_4_10) over all parameter lists p : β → A with #β ≤ g σ + ls K. β is quantified inside the iff, since for one fixed β the iff fails when β is small; the bound is g σ + ls K because PlacedTester bounds positions of I and ≤ g(σ) positions support ≤ g(σ) + ℓ elements of A. Clause 3: the old form compared x, y ∈ A under g₀ = g₁ on A, which forces x = y and holds for any injection A → μ; it is now a code for the elements of all μ-extensions (B, f) of A, with code B₀ f₀ x = code B₁ f₁ y iff an amalgam over A identifies x with y (the old form is the case B₀ = B₁ = A). Hard edges proposition_4_2 → theorem_4_11 (strong-map clause, StableDiagram.to_strong) and proposition_4_8 → theorem_4_11 (placed tester) added.

Prop 5.6 is done (SingleModelScheme.lean, SingleModelPackage.lean), with a strengthened statement: a one-vertex working package with presentations and an object at every eligible level, on an unbounded class of closure points of {D.t, g}. Definition 5.2 was repaired first, because the planned statement was refutable (Lean-checked obstructions). (1) WorkingScheme.diagram_iso is for lists with #α < μ, and WorkingScheme.diagram_preserved for lists with #α < μ and #α < ν: unbounded, the two fields applied to the list of all occurrences of an object make every permitted arrow between objects at one level vertexwise bijective, and the stable diagram D only controls bounded lists. (2) IsSaturated.saturated assumes ∀ i, ext (Sum.inl i) = base i: the witness extends the list whose diagram is that of the actual list (otherwise ext was unrelated to base and xs). (3) HasChainUnions.union assumes the cocone condition ∀ i j, comp (le i j) (toZ j) = toZ i in its universal property: without it a two-element constant family identifies any two permitted arrows X → Z, which with mixed downward closure refutes every package having an object. diagram_trans / diagram_reindex / diagram_restrict / diagram_refl / diagram_symm / diagram_empty are unchanged (unbounded). Callers updated: namedWorkingScheme now takes #ι < μ0 and the tail bounds μ0 ≤ μ, ℵ₀ ≤ μ; Props 5.7, 5.8, 5.9 remain proved. Known residual: HasChainUnions.union quantifies over arrows le i j for every ordered pair (i, j) with strict composition, so its families consist of mutually inverse isomorphisms and, with the cocone condition, the clause holds in every scheme (take U := obj i₀); a faithful clause would index le over i ≤ j in a directed order. Left unchanged; the real content for single models is SingleModelData.exists_directed_union. Sections 6–11 that consume chain unions should re-index the clause when they need it.

Lemma 6.1 is done (ParameterOrbits.lean), with a repaired statement. The bare-scheme statement was refutable, and assuming a working package with presentations is not enough: nothing there makes the automorphisms of the vertex models (Lemma 4.5) structural isomorphisms of the scheme (counterexample pattern, not formalized: isomorphisms that preserve a colouring by more than χ colours). The link is the new hypothesis AssemblesStructIso W b; the English bound b is kept (hb : b + σ < χ), together with the Lemma 4.5 bound hχ, categoricity at the eligible levels hcat and [CategoricalUnbounded K]. The shape must have no specified map (hedge): vertex automorphisms from Lemma 4.5 need not commute with the maps of a system. This replaces a one-vertex hypothesis, which is not needed (any finite number of vertices is covered) and does not suffice for this proof (a vertex with a specified map to itself). AssemblesStructIso holds for the Prop 5.6 scheme with b = 0 and for the Prop 5.7 named scheme with b + #names. Hard edge lemma_4_5 → lemma_6_1 added. Prop 6.3 is unblocked.

Lem 6.5 is done (PlacedComparisons.lean), with a repaired statement. The old form had SameGaloisType (scheme amalgamation, which is Thm 6.6) on the left of the iff, a merely monotone g (the iff fails for small g), and a bare WorkingScheme with no presentation to place a tuple in; English Lem 6.5 does not use an amalgamation relation on types. It is now at the level of a presentation, under hL : ClosedLevel K E D g μ with I a well-order of size μ, A = E(I), and tuples d₀, d₁ of length ≤ σ < μ in strong μ-extensions B₀, B₁ of A: (1) some placement lifts the bounded diagrams of d₀ (Placement.LiftsBounded); (2) any two such placements agree over all of A (Placement.AgreeOn … Set.univ); (3) for lifts P₀ of d₀ and P₁ of d₁, P₀.AgreeOn P₁ Set.univ iff the diagrams of d₀ and d₁ agree at the bounded levels ρ < μ over all parameter lists p : β → A with #β ≤ g σ + ls K (the right side of Thm 4.11 clause 2). σ is any infinite bound on the length, in place of |v| + ℵ₀. The last sentence of the English statement (other natural parameter layouts) is not formalized: NaturalParameterLayout has no placement data. Proof: (1), (2) are Lemma 4.10 (exists_boundedDiagramLift, Placement.LiftsBounded.agreeOn_univ); (3) ← is the placed tester (agreeOn_univ_of_tests), (3) → is new (Placement.LiftsBounded.same_of_agreeOn: equal comparisons make the placement of d₀ lift d₁, by Placement.LiftsBounded.of_agreeOn, so both tuples have the diagram of its placed tuple; this holds for every bounded query). Hard edges added: lemma_4_10 → lemma_6_5, proposition_4_8 → lemma_6_5, and proposition_6_3 → lemma_6_5 (the English proof says Proposition 6.3 identifies the full placed comparisons; in Lean its PlacedTester is the tester of ClosedLevel). lemma_6_4 → lemma_6_5 stays hard: the English proof applies Lemma 6.4, and the Lean proof reaches the same compact_placement through Lemma 4.10. Thm 6.6 is done by packaging ClosedLevel.amalgamation and ClosedLevel.tuple_amalgamation_iff (ClosedLevelTypes.lean / Thm 4.11). Statement repair: dropped bare WorkingScheme / SameGaloisType / unconstrained g; presentation-level under ClosedLevel K E D g μ with amalgamation of strong μ-extensions and the tuple-amalgamation iff at bounded σ < μ with #β ≤ g σ + ls K. Hard edge theorem_4_11 → theorem_6_6; lemma_6_5 → theorem_6_6 softened (English ω-tower / Lem 6.4–6.5 narrative; Lean path is Thm 4.11). Cor 6.7 is done; see the Cor 6.7 note.

Cor 6.7 is done (LargerLevelRealization.lean), with a repaired statement. The old form quantified over a bare WorkingScheme (Tail / SystemArrow / permitted) with no closed levels, strongness, sizes or testing bound for the Thm 4.11 engine to use, and had neither the prescribed tuple nor the type clause. It is now presentation-level under ClosedLevel K E D g ν, ClosedLevel K E D g μ, ν < μ, for a strong f : A → B of ν-models and a strong i : A → N into a μ-model: (1) a strong B → N extends i; (2) the image of a tuple d of B of length < ν may be prescribed as z in N when the diagrams of (d, f p) and (z, i p) agree at the bounds ρ < ν for all p : β → A with #β ≤ g(#α ⊔ ℵ₀) + ls K; (3) a tuple of N of length < ν lies in a strong ν-submodel B' of N containing A, with the same diagrams over A at ρ < ν. Proof of (2): N ≅ E(Below μ) by categoricity at μ; the images of A and z use ≤ ν positions, so they lie in N₀ = E(S), S a suborder of size ν (exists_suborder_cover), and A → N₀ is strong by coherence; ClosedLevel.exists_tuple_amalgam at ν gives a ν-amalgam P of B and N₀ over A identifying d with z; N₀ → N is an order map of the presentation and μ ≥ t(ν) is a categoricity cardinal, so exists_strong_embedding_over (the Thm 4.11 tower at source level ν, target chart Below μ) embeds P into N over N₀. The target is not enlarged and no comparison of length ν is made in a ν-model. The English proof instead runs the exhaustion of Thm 6.6 directly into N, with compact placement in a chart of N and saturation at μ; that saturation step is not formalized. A direct Lean version by lift extensions was tried and not closed: D.exists_transport into N matches the previously assigned list but not the image of A, and D.of_strong from the ν-model A gives no comparison of length ν (t(ν) > ν). Hard edge theorem_4_11 → corollary_6_7; theorem_6_6 → corollary_6_7 softened (English shared exhaustion; theorem_6_6 is not called). Lemma 6.9 is unblocked (its only hard dep was 6.7); its bare-scheme statement remains for a later repair.

ClosedLevelAmalgam.lean: A ≅ E(I), I of order type μ; G = E(J) of a categoricity size ≥ t(μ) (exists_categorical_extension); LiftsTuple = a tuple of E(J) lifting the bounded diagrams over A; one step exists_lift_extension (Lemma 4.10 lift of the longer tuple, uniqueness at level μ over all of A against the given lift, transport into G); countable tower of strong submodels smaller than μ (exists_strong_tower, countable cofinality); each lifted stage is a strong map by D.to_strong in a common hull (exists_strong_of_liftsTuple); the union is a strong map B → G over A extending a prescribed lift (exists_strong_embedding_over); amalgams exists_amalgam_of_common_lift / exists_amalgam_of_agreeOn (LS hull of size μ in G); sufficiency of the tests by the placed tester (agreeOn_univ_of_tests), necessity by D.of_strong (StableDiagram.same_of_amalgam). ClosedLevelTypes.lean: ClosedLevel.amalgamation, ClosedLevel.tuple_amalgamation_iff, ClosedLevel.singleton_types; a singleton placement is coded by its label and the cuts of its finite support in I (Placement.singletonCode, ≤ μ codes mk_singletonCode_le, equal codes give the same comparison over A by sameNaturalDiagram_of_pattern), code of an element = least code of a placement lifting it. Statement changes: [CategoricalUnbounded K], E, hg : PlacedTester K E D g; clause 2 with ℵ₀ ≤ σ and bounded-level tests ρ < μ over all parameter lists of length ≤ g σ + ls K (β inside the iff); clause 3 generalized from the degenerate x, y ∈ A form to elements of all μ-extensions of A. nodes.label: Lem 6.1
nodes.detail: No sorry (axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound). ParameterOrbits.lean: AssemblesStructIso W b (at every object, strong vertex automorphisms that fix a set of at most b occurrences and commute with the specified maps assemble into a structural isomorphism); exists_vertexwise_orbit_reps (Lemma 4.5 at each vertex over the parameters at that vertex; a tuple of occurrences is coded by the vertices of its entries and the per-vertex representatives, at most χ^σ = χ codes since the shape is finite); WorkingScheme.exists_parameter_orbit_reps (explicit threshold: the κ0 of Lemma 4.5 and χ < μ; the vertex automorphisms fix params ∪ B, are a structural isomorphism by AssemblesStructIso, and W.diagram_iso applies since #(ι ⊕ ρ) ≤ χ < μ). Statement changes: the bare-scheme statement was refutable (DiagramEq may be equality of lists). Added [CategoricalUnbounded K], hcat (categoricity at the eligible levels), hχ : ls K + 2^(2^σ) ≤ χ (the bound of Lemma 4.5), hiso : AssemblesStructIso W b, hedge : ∀ i j, ¬ S.specified i j; kept the English b and hb : b + σ < χ. IsWorkingPackage and HasPresentations are not assumed: they do not make vertex automorphisms structural isomorphisms (counterexample pattern, not formalized: isomorphisms that preserve a colouring by more than χ colours), and the proof does not use them. hedge instead of one vertex: Lemma 4.5 gives vertex automorphisms one vertex at a time, which need not commute with the maps of a system, so shapes with a specified map (including one vertex with a map to itself) are not covered; any finite number of vertices without maps is. hiso is discharged by assemblesStructIso_bijective (IsStructIso = vertexwise bijective, B = ∅), SingleModelData.assemblesStructIso (Prop 5.6 scheme, b = 0), WorkingScheme.assemblesStructIso_named (Prop 5.7 scheme, b + #names); SingleModelData.exists_parameter_orbit_reps is the lemma for the Prop 5.6 scheme with no scheme hypothesis left. proposition_5_6 does not export hedge, hcat or hiso for its existential scheme; callers use SingleModelData.scheme or the statement of Prop 5.6 must be extended. The block-transposition clause of the English statement is lemma_4_6.

nodes.label: Infra: whole-block diff
